description: PERMANENTLY DELETES everything in the run: its machines (with their boot disks and public addresses), its volumes and its networks, then checks each one gone and its billing stopped. A volume of the account that was attached to a run's machine from outside the run is kept, detached. This cannot be undone, so confirm with the user first unless they asked for it. It runs in the background: call get_run until status is ended (all gone) or end_failed (the report says what is left and why; end_run again retries).

id.description: The run's id, from create_run or list_runs.

name: end_run
title: End run
